user.description: Shoebox manages the pictures in your media folder: folders, upload, rotate and crop, and rotating pictures for dashboards and displays.

user.title: Rotation
user.description: A rotation shows the pictures its patterns select, one at a time, in path order.

data_description.name: Shown as the rotation's device and entity name.
data_description.patterns: Globs over paths below the media folder ("*" within a folder, "**" at any depth), or "re:" followed by a regular expression. When the first selects no pictures, the next is used.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description:
{count} pictures match, using {pattern}. The first are:

{examples}

init.description: Shoebox keeps pictures prepared at the sizes dashboards and devices ask for. The cache now holds {files} pictures ({size} MB).

data_description.cache_size: When the cache grows past this, the pictures used least recently are removed. 0 turns the cache off: pictures are prepared on every request.
data_description.clear_cache: Removes every prepared picture. They are made again when needed.
data_description.show_in_sidebar: The Shoebox panel for administrators. Actions, entities and device pictures work either way.

list.name: List media
list.description: Lists the files and folders below the media folder that match a pattern.

pattern.name: Pattern
pattern.description: A glob over paths below the media folder ("*" within a folder, "**" at any depth, "?", "[...]"), or "re:" followed by a regular expression.

type.name: Type
type.description: Only pictures, other files or folders.

create_folder.name: Create folder
create_folder.description: Creates a folder below the media folder, with any missing parent folders.

path.name: Path
path.description: The new folder, for example "Family/2025 Summer".

move.name: Move
move.description: Moves a file or folder into another folder. Nothing is overwritten.

path.name: Path
path.description: File or folder below the media folder, for example "Family/beach.jpg".

to.name: To
to.description: The folder to move into; empty for the media folder itself.

rename.name: Rename
rename.description: Renames a file or folder in place. Nothing is overwritten.

path.name: Path
path.description: File or folder below the media folder, for example "Family/beach.jpg".

name.name: New name
name.description: The new name, without a folder.

delete.name: Delete
delete.description: Deletes a file, or a folder with everything in it. This cannot be undone.

path.name: Path
path.description: File or folder below the media folder, for example "Family/beach.jpg".

rotate.name: Rotate picture
rotate.description: Turns a JPEG picture by changing its EXIF orientation; the picture data is not re-encoded.

path.name: Path
path.description: Picture below the media folder, for example "Family/beach.jpg".

by.name: By
by.description: How far to turn the picture as shown, clockwise.

orientation.name: Orientation
orientation.description: Sets the EXIF orientation (1 to 8) instead of turning.

crop.name: Crop picture
crop.description: Crops a JPEG picture by storing the crop in its XMP data, as photo editors do; the picture data is not changed.

path.name: Path
path.description: Picture below the media folder, for example "Family/beach.jpg".

left.name: Left
left.description: The left edge of the crop, as a fraction of the picture as shown (0 to 1).

top.name: Top
top.description: The top edge of the crop, as a fraction of the picture as shown (0 to 1).

right.name: Right
right.description: The right edge of the crop, as a fraction of the picture as shown (0 to 1).

bottom.name: Bottom
bottom.description: The bottom edge of the crop, as a fraction of the picture as shown (0 to 1).

invalid_type.message: The type must be one of {types}.

exists_not_folder.message: "{path}" exists and is not a folder.

invalid_file_name.message: "{name}" is not a valid file name.

upload_type.message: "{name}": only pictures, videos and audio can be uploaded.

rotate_by_90.message: Rotate by a multiple of 90 degrees.

jpeg_only.message: {name}: edits are only possible in JPEG files.

metadata_too_large.message: The metadata segment is too large.

crop_range.message: The crop needs 0 <= left < right <= 1 and 0 <= top < bottom <= 1.

xmp_unsupported.message: {name}: the XMP data has no rdf:Description, not changed.

invalid_fit.message: The fit must be cover or contain.

crop_sides.message: Give left, top, right and bottom, or clear the crop.
